name: zsys_read_tsc64
description: zSys::ReadTsc64 splits a monotonic 64-bit timing counter into high and low dwords. The VC5 raw-assembly profile recovers the original RDTSC helper.
known_limits: The native smoke exercises the portable fallback outside the VC5 raw-assembly profile.
Binary Ninja notes show the retail helper has an awkward register-clobber shape around EDX; tier S evidence intentionally preserves the retail byte shape.
tier_s_evidence: 2026-06-05: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b3b20 passed under vc5_zsys_cpu_raw_asm with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
